title: NTA NIFT 2026 Stage 2 Result: Out for B.Des B.F.Tech M.Des #NIFT2026 #NTAEntrance #FashionDesign
intro: National Testing Agency (NTA-NIFT) has Officially Released Stage 2 Admit Card for the Admission of National Institute of Fashion Technology NIFT 2026.  Stage 2 Exam Held On April 26, 2026 & Stage 2 Result Released On June 3, 2026. All Interested Candidate Can Download Stage 2 Result Now in The Given Link Below
